outcome: Metrics authoring now has bounded typed control flow aligned with the Rust runtime
owner_impact: Metrics can now express ordinary thresholded, counting and piecewise measurements with True/False, scalar comparisons, and/or/not, and if/elif/else. Branch-local scalar/vector values are usable only when definitely assigned on every continuing path; exhaustive branches may return the metric directly. Iteration remains bounded to capability-backed snapshot collections and Metrics remains read-only with unavailable snapshot/controller information blocked.

Regression coverage includes thresholded counting, exhaustive branch assignment, branch returns, vector/math expressions, branch-aware collection alias lowering and read-only boundary rejection.

No scientific capability, candidate availability, MCP tool count, CI/CD, polling, retry, timeout or development-workflow rule changed.
